query:
SELECT p.id, p.enterpriseName, p.status, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_diagnosis_tasks t WHERE t.projectId = p.id) as taskCount,
  (SELECT status FROM ai_diagnosis_tasks t WHERE t.projectId = p.id ORDER BY t.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) as latestTaskStatus
FROM geo_projects p 
WHERE p.ownerUserId = 16740006
ORDER BY p.id DESC
LIMIT 5;
